prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Arsenic (비소) itself — the sovereign of the Arsenic Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: arsenic: the patient, elegant poison — white arsenic, the 'inheritance powder' of whispered court intrigues, until James Marsh's test of 1836 caught it as a dark silvery mirror on porcelain; Scheele's green of 1775, the dazzling poison-emerald pigment that papered nineteenth-century parlours; golden orpiment and red-orange realgar, ancient pigments it forms with sulfur; Salvarsan of 1910, the first 'magic bullet' drug; a steel-grey metalloid that skips melting and sublimes with a smell of garlic; poison and cure held in one smiling hand. Palette: poison-emerald Scheele's green, golden orpiment yellow, realgar orange-red, metallic steel grey, porcelain white.

World (fixed): a temple kingdom of poison and cure: a sanctuary of golden orpiment mosaics and red-orange realgar pillars, secret galleries painted a dazzling poison green, a silent court garden of pale flowers where heirs to the throne have a way of quietly vanishing, and an altar where the same white powder is weighed out as death or as medicine. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) leather armor with a short cloak, a lowered hood, bracers and boots — a light, agile ranger's silhouette; 2) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 3) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 4) angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette; 5) thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette; 6) a fur cloak, leather straps, minimal metal plates and bone and tooth ornaments — a rugged, wild warrior silhouette; 7) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): poison-emerald Scheele's green, golden orpiment yellow, realgar orange-red, metallic steel grey, porcelain white.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): vivid poison-emerald Scheele's-green hair with a cold steel-grey sheen. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (As) and atomic number (33) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
My detailed design: Choose silhouette 5, thin leaf-patterned armour and flowing fabric panels with a slender circlet. Signature construction: emerald armoured leaves graduate into porcelain-white overlapping scales along the hips, their edges red-orange and golden like realgar and orpiment strata; asymmetric flowing panels with a high slit. Long poison-emerald braided ponytail with steel-grey sheen, wispy straight fringe, jade-grey wide almond eyes, small oval adult face and rose-beige skin, dark cherry lips. She stands by a pale-flowered temple garden fountain, body facing front, face looking toward viewer with quiet confidence, both empty hands lowered open and separated from the body. Complete figure with feet inside the image.
